heading: Emergency & After-Hours Care
body: If your pet is in crisis, call us immediately — day or night. Our team will guide you through what to do before you arrive.
steps: Call ahead so our team can prepare for your pet's condition.
Keep your pet warm, calm, and as still as safely possible.
Do not give food, water, or medication unless instructed.
Bring any medications or toxins your pet may have ingested.
